text: In the third century, Queen Himiko ruled there; she was said to keep the chiefs in line with sorcery, and China sent her a hundred bronze mirrors.
spoken: In the third century, Queen Hee-mee-ko ruled there; she was said to keep the chiefs in line with sorcery, and China sent her a hundred bronze mirrors.
